description_en: Queries Browser Monitoring data based on a Simple Log Service (SLS) query statement

kebab_example: aliyun arms get-retcode-data-by-query --pid 'atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf****' --query 't : pv|select sum(times) as pv , approx_distinct(uid) as uv , (date-date%3600000) as date  group by date' --from 1668687302 --to 1668688000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRetcodeDataByQuery

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

On the Browser Monitoring > Browser Monitoring list page in the ARMS console, click the name of the target application. The URL in the browser address bar contains the pid of the browser monitoring application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the pid in the xxx%40xxx format. For example, if the pid in the URL is eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****, replace %40 with @. The modified pid is eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的前端监控 > 前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含前端应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，应用需要对xxx%40xxx格式的pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****，则需要将%40替换为@，即：eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.name: pid

parameters.example: t : pv|select sum(times) as pv , approx_distinct(uid) as uv , (date-date%3600000) as date  group by date
parameters.help_en: The query statement that complies with the SLS Logstore query syntax
parameters.help_zh: 符合SLS Logstore查询语法的查询语句
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to
